title: Exotic Smoky Slovakian Pork Dumplings
description: A smoky and crumbly Slovakian dish featuring cardamom, perfect for a date night, made with gluten-free friendly ingredients and infused oil.

ingredients.name: ground pork
ingredients.notes: preferably with a high fat content

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine the ground pork, smoked paprika, cardamom powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl and mix well.
Gradually add the gluten-free flour to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Add the egg to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Brush the tops of the dumplings with the infused oil.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
